빌드 / Run
Run Build Task : ctrl + cmd + B
Run Test Task : ctrl + cmd + R

# Header Run
1. gcc ./filename.c ... ./filename.c -c
2. gcc ./filename.o ... ./filename.o -o filename.exe
3. ./filename.exe

# SQL
1. gcc ./filename.c -o filename -lsqlite3
2. ./filename

# Header + SQL
1. gcc ./filename.c ... -o filename_ -lsqlite3
2. ./filename_
